abstract.p: Multi-label emotion classification in lowresource languages remains challenging due to limited annotated data and model adaptability. To address this, we fine-tune large language models (LLMs) using a sentence-label pairing approach, optimizing efficiency while improving classification performance. Evaluating on Sundanese, Indonesian, and Javanese, our method outperforms conventional classifierbased fine-tuning and achieves strong zero-shot cross-lingual transfer. Notably, our approach ranks first in the Sundanese subset of SemEval-2025 Task 11 Track A. Our findings demonstrate the effectiveness of LLM fine-tuning for low-resource emotion classification, underscoring the importance of tailoring adaptation strategies to specific language families in multilingual contexts. Our source code is available at: https://github.com/LazarusNLP/ SemEval2025-Emotion-Analysis.
